text:
[Council File 26-1445]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
HOMELESSNESS AND HEALTH COMMITTEE REPORT relative to a report on Operation Healthy Streets operation notifications in Skid Row and recommendations on how to enhance the notification process.
Recommendations for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Jurado - Soto-Martinez):
1. DIRECT the Bureau of Sanitation (BOS) to report back within 30 days on its policy and procedures for Operation Healthy Streets (OHS) operation notifications and recommendations on how to enhance the notification process overall. This report should include:
a. A description of whether a formal notification system exists for OHS in Skid Row and if so, the methods, advance notice timelines, and staffing provided.
b. An assessment of the current OHS map for Skid Row, including its accuracy, clarity and how it is distributed to residents in the area.
c. An assessment of inconsistencies in notification practices between OHS CARE and OHS CARE+ operations.
d. An analysis of whether reliance on permanent metal signage contributes to gaps or inconsistencies in notifying residents of scheduled OHS operations.
e. An assessment of the costs of removing permanent metal signage and the staffing needed to post paper notices and proper documentation.
2. INSTRUCT the BOS to develop recommendations to improve notification procedures.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: A motion asking for a report on how residents in Skid Row are notified before Operation Healthy Streets operations, with recommendations to improve that notice process.
